Watch: Keep a close eye on whether the AI/tech selloff deepens or shows signs of stabilizing. Also, monitor the broader market's reaction to the S&P 500's losing streak.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged tech positions.
plays: Your stop at 35.7 for MSFU is critical; consider trimming if it breaks that level, as it's a leveraged position.
With SOXL down -79.84% and MUU -64.05%, reassess if their current stops are realistic or if deeper cuts are needed to manage margin risk.
